reason: A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin for diagnosing failures by capturing bounded, redacted session, Git, runtime, plugin, and stack-trace evidence into offline ZIP capsules.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地故障诊断插件，可在工具或 Agent 失败时生成经过限量采集和脱敏处理的证据 ZIP 包。
summaries.en: A local-first DeepSeek Harness plugin that creates bounded, redacted ZIP evidence capsules when tool or agent failures occur.

capabilities: Monitors DeepSeek Harness session and agent error events
Collects bounded Git, runtime, plugin, and session evidence
Writes local ZIP failure capsules to the project filesystem
Redacts configured secret patterns and credentials before export
Resolves JavaScript stack traces with local source maps
